title: 第一卷 第9章 绝境反杀第一卷 第10章 本命天赋觉醒
slug: 武道长生从猎户开始刷熟练度修行
lines: 林子里。
宋忠与手下五人迅速散开，在附近数十丈范围内搜索。
他们手持刀斧，拨开草丛，查看石缝。
一个三角眼汉子与同伴搜索到一片茂密的狼尾蕨丛旁。
两人随意用刀拨弄几下，目光扫过，只觉得那是片普通蕨丛，便从旁走过。
就在他们转身的刹那——
蕨丛中，一道与环境近乎融合的绿色身影动了！
秦猛如捕食的毒蛇暴起，环首刀化作冷电，自后方精准掠过三角眼汉子的脖颈。
刀锋切过皮肉骨骼，三角眼汉子身体一僵，眼中爆出惊恐，软软栽倒。
一股滚烫的热流涌入秦猛体内。
另一人骇然转身，正好看到同伴倒下的身影，以及鬼魅般扑来的秦猛。
他只吐出一字，秦猛的刀已如毒龙出洞直刺心口。
那汉子仓皇举刀格挡。
金铁交鸣，汉子手臂剧震：好大力气！
他刚想后退呼救，秦猛刀锋一压一滑，避开格挡，自下而上撩起。
“嗤啦！”
刀锋自肋下切入，斜向上切开胸膛，汉子张嘴想惨叫，被秦猛一拳打碎喉咙，瞪眼倒下。
秦猛呼吸平稳，迅速搜走钱袋，整个过程不到五息。
他没有停留，身形再次融入环境。
远处，横肉汉子隐约听到异响，停下脚步侧耳倾听：“狗子，老六？”
没有回应。
他握紧刀，朝声音传来的方向摸去。
绕过巨石，眼前是片开阔林地。
突然，左侧大树后黑影闪出。
是秦猛本人。
他如猎豹扑出，速度快到拉出残影！
横肉汉子惊觉时，刀光已至面门。
他怒吼挥刀，但秦猛的速度更快，刀锋诡异一偏，避开格挡，直刺咽喉！
刀尖透颈而出！
横肉汉子眼中生机迅速消散，手中刀“哐当”
落地。
秦猛抽刀，迅速搜刮。
他能感觉到体内命源已近临界点。
没过多久，第四名落单打手被他从背后一刀断喉。
当领队宋忠终于察觉到不对劲——手下接连失去声息，呼唤也无人回应时，他顿感不妙。
“老六！
横三！”
content_en:
In the woods.
Song Zhong and his five men quickly dispersed and searched within a few dozen feet nearby.
Armed with knives and axes, they pushed aside the grass and looked into the cracks in the rocks.
A man with triangular eyes and his companions searched for a dense wolf tail fern bush.
The two of them fiddled with the knives a few times and glanced over it. They thought it was just an ordinary fern bush and walked past it.
The moment they turned around——
Among the ferns, a green figure that was almost integrated with the environment moved!
Qin Meng rose up like a venomous snake preying on prey, and his sword turned into cold lightning, accurately passing over the neck of the triangular-eyed man from behind.
"Poof!"
The blade cut through the flesh and bones, and the man with triangular eyes froze, fear burst out in his eyes, and he fell down.
[Life source +15%]
A hot stream of heat poured into Qin Meng's body.
The other person turned around in shock, just in time to see the fallen figure of his companion and Qin Meng rushing towards him like a ghost.
"In-"
He only spat out one word, and Qin Meng's knife pierced his heart like a poisonous dragon coming out of its cave.
The man hurriedly raised his knife to block.
"Cang!"
The metal and iron clashed, and the man's arm shook violently: What a strong force!
Just as he was about to step back and call for help, Qin Meng's blade slid forward, avoiding the block, and raised it from bottom to top.
"Tsk!"
The blade cut under the ribs and sliced open the chest diagonally upwards. The man opened his mouth to scream, but Qin Meng smashed his throat with a punch and fell down with a stare.
[Life source +16%]
Qin Meng breathed steadily and quickly searched the money bag. The whole process took less than five breaths.
He didn't stop, and his body blended into the environment again.
In the distance, the rugged man vaguely heard a strange noise and stopped to listen: "Gouzi, Lao Liu?"
No response.
He held the knife tightly and touched it in the direction of the sound.
After walking around the boulders, there is an open woodland in front of us.
Suddenly, a black shadow flashed out from behind the big tree on the left.
It was Qin Meng himself.
He pounced like a cheetah, so fast that he pulled out the afterimage!
When the ruthless man woke up in surprise, the light of the sword had reached his face.
He roared and swung the knife, but Qin Meng was faster. The blade of the knife deflected strangely, avoiding the block, and stabbed straight into the throat!
"Poof!"
The tip of the knife came out of the neck!
The life in the tough man's eyes quickly dissipated, and the knife in his hand "clanged"
Landed.
[Life source +18%]
Qin Meng drew his knife and searched quickly.
He could feel that the life source in his body was approaching the critical point.
Not long after, the fourth lone thug had his throat slashed from behind.
[Life source +14%]
When the team leader Song Zhong finally noticed something was wrong - his men lost their voices one after another and no one responded to their calls, he suddenly felt bad.
"Old Six!
Heng San! "
